All four items are in template v11 (202bbcb), now the latest. v11 leaves the gate unchanged.
(1) Builder records: CLAUDE.md says a path under docs/, meta_agent/ or contracts/, or plan.md, is the builder's record, is not here and is not looked for. The build marks every task, replay item and TEMPLATE.json that names one with builder_records: the path, the fact that the record is the builder's, and the person's words with their date where an answer's recorded_in names that record.
(2) Order: CLAUDE.md has a Workflow section filled from intake.workflow. Without one, it says the request gave no order and that an order read off the descriptions is an inference. The schema does not admit the key yet; asked in 20261117-meta-macbook-20261116-1-5.
(3) Installer: before an install, src/run_tool.py looks on PATH for the installer the contract names. Where it is missing, the call returns an unavailable error, code <TOOL>-INSTALLER-MISSING, that names the installer and says putting it there is the person's step. The Tools line and CLAUDE.md say the same.
(4) Start task: tasks/001-start.md says that a scientific not_run for want of an engine's environment is followed by the agent's own install and a second validate_tasks run.
Tested in test_template_v11 on two kinds each (pixi with uv, a simulation chain with a spectrometer chain, a scientific task with a replay item). With the mechanisms taken out, 10 of 11 fail; the eleventh is the install-runs control. meta_agent/tests 261 OK, contracts/tests 110 OK.
